I've been farming this land my whole life, since I was a boy helping my father. Let me think through what I'll do this year.

My 18 mu — I keep about 4 mu in cotton, the rest (14 mu) I do wheat then maize, same as every year. Cotton is troublesome, lots of spraying, my back hurts, so I don't plant more than that. But cotton price is okay when the bolls are clean, so I keep some.

**Wheat (14 mu, winter):** Last October I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, same as always — the 15-15-15 kind, 40 kg bags. Then in spring when the wheat turns green I spread half a bag of urea per mu. That's what my neighbor Old Wang does and his wheat looks the same as mine. If I put less, the wheat turns yellow and I get scared. I water three times — before winter, at returning green, and when the grain is filling. Spray twice for aphids and that yellow rust on the leaves. I buy the improved seed from the village station, not the old kind anymore. Rotary till after maize harvest. Last year I got about 450 kg per mu, I'll plan the same.

**Maize (14 mu, summer):** After wheat harvest in June I just push the seeder through the stubble — no ploughing, everyone does no-till now, saves money and the machine man charges less. Hybrid seed, the Zhengdan kind, I buy what the dealer suggests, same as the neighbors. Maize eats a lot of fertilizer — I use one bag compound at seeding and then when the maize is knee-high I broadcast one bag of urea per mu. If I don't, the ears are small. Water two times if the rain is poor. One spray for the borer worm. Usually get around 550 kg per mu.

**Cotton (4 mu, spring):** Cotton needs deep ploughing before sowing, I hire the tractor. Sow in late April when soil is warm. I use the Bt hybrid seed — the one against bollworm — everyone switched to it years ago. Cotton needs feeding through the whole season. I put one bag compound as base, then two times I add urea, maybe half a bag each time. Water three times from the well. Spraying is the hard part — cotton attracts everything: aphids, spider mites, the leaf roller — I spray maybe ten times through the season, I just watch the leaves and spray when I see trouble. Get about 250 kg seed cotton per mu in a good year.

Money is tight with 6 mouths, but I won't cut fertilizer. A bad harvest costs more than one extra bag. If something goes wrong I can't feed everyone. I do what I know works.
